_note: NL -> SQL -> pinned answer question bank (proposal archive/database/company_metrics_grain_and_bank §3.3, seeded 2026-11-11). Entries carry the NL question, the shape that answers it (metric_value for certified-grain lookups, sql for everything else), and an operator-attested pin computed from the committed snapshot and cross-checked against the live store. The probe runs this bank ALONGSIDE the frozen set by default; --no-bank skips it; --fail-on drifted is the CI gate. metric entries are keyed by ruling A1: one row per (entity, metric_label, period, consolidated) — latest filing within scope (ruling A1/B1). Restatements re-pin explicitly, never silently.

questions.question: Which company does ISIN INE040A01034 identify?

params.sql: SELECT entity_name FROM sqlite__entity_identifiers WHERE identifier_value = 'INE040A01034'

questions.question: Which companies does ICICI Bank compete with?

params.sql: SELECT target FROM sqlite__graph_edges WHERE source = 'ICICI Bank' AND edge_type = 'competes_with' ORDER BY target

questions.question: Which companies are in the Financial Services sector?

params.sql: SELECT DISTINCT hi.entity_name FROM sqlite__hyper_incidences hi JOIN sqlite__hyper_edges he ON he.id = hi.edge_id WHERE he.edge_type = 'sector' AND he.label = 'Financial_Services' ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Which companies did Reliance Industries acquire?

params.sql: SELECT DISTINCT counterparty_entity FROM sqlite__events WHERE entity = 'Reliance Industries' AND event_type = 'acquisition' AND counterparty_entity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Who is the ultimate parent of HDFC AMC?

params.sql: SELECT ultimate_parent FROM sqlite__ultimate_parent WHERE company = 'HDFC AMC'

questions.question: Which companies is 5paisa Capital connected to beyond the obvious graph edges?

params.sql: SELECT b FROM sqlite__hidden_connections WHERE a = '5paisa Capital' UNION SELECT a FROM sqlite__hidden_connections WHERE b = '5paisa Capital' ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Where does the industry concept 'Advertising Agencies' map to in the NIC 2008 scheme?

params.sql: SELECT target_concept FROM sqlite__concept_mappings WHERE source_scheme = 'industry' AND source_concept = 'Advertising Agencies' AND target_scheme = 'nic2008' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY 1
